sections.title: Mini-games
sections.note: Every prize worth winning once; seven of them give Pieces of Heart.

items.name: Cucco Ranch
items.howTo: Talk to the Cucco Girl and dodge the Cuccos for 30 seconds; one touch and you lose. Each level unlocks the next.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon and Zelda Universe call it Cucco Rush, IGN Cucco Dash. After Rooster comes Endless (10 Rupees): survive as long as you can; Zelda Wiki says 100 seconds earns Rupees and dodging until the 999.99-second limit makes you Cuccomaster (3,000 Rupees).

tiers.name: Rooster
tiers.reward: Piece of Heart and 150 Rupees (150 Rupees after that)

items.name: Rupee Rush (Hyrule)
items.howTo: Pay the Rupee Rush Gal 50 Rupees, grab Rupees and talk to her again before the hidden 30-second limit. Score 100 or more.
items.notes: Over 30 seconds and you keep nothing. Finishing just before the limit multiplies your take (Zelda Dungeon: ×2 under 3 seconds left, ×3 under 1). Some Rupees are under tiles (Tornado Rod) or in boulders (Hammer). A Lost Maiamai is on the course's south wall.

items.name: Hyrule Hotfoot
items.area: Lake Hylia (Racing Bro on the north-east ledge)
items.howTo: Pay the Racing Bro 20 Rupees and run to the other Racing Bro behind Rosso's house, without Irene's broom in Hyrule.
items.notes: After the second race, an advanced round pays 300 Rupees each time you beat your best time (Zelda Wiki). Shortcut: step into Lorule, ride the broom to Skull Woods and come back through Rosso's house.

items.name: Fortune's Choice
items.howTo: Pay 200 Rupees and open three of the 15 chests. Play until you find the Piece of Heart.
items.reward: Piece of Heart (once; a Gold Rupee replaces it)
items.notes: Other prizes: Gold, Silver, Red and Green Rupees and the three monster parts (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Rupee Rush (Lorule)
items.howTo: Pay the Rupee Rush Guy 100 Rupees and score 150 or more before the hidden 30-second limit.
items.notes: The Sand Rod reaches the most valuable Rupees. A Lost Maiamai is on the course's north-west wall.

items.name: Octoball Derby
items.area: Lorule's Haunted Grove (south-west of Lorule Castle)
items.howTo: Pay 50 Rupees and bat Octo's 30 pitches into pots: red pots 1 Rupee, gold pots 5. Three pots in a row bring a crow worth 20. Score 100 or more.
items.notes: Hitting a crab resets the pots. Push the Circle Pad up or down to change the height of your hits.

items.name: Treacherous Tower
items.area: Lorule Death Mountain (where the Tower of Hera is in Hyrule)
items.howTo: Pay the Devilish Girl and clear every floor of enemies. Each course unlocks the next; once inside you can't leave until you win or fall.
items.notes: Beating your best time pays extra Rupees. Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon agree on the floors and prices.

tiers.name: Advanced again
tiers.howTo: Clear the Advanced course a second time.
